import RNA
import random

target = "((....))..(...(...(..(.(..(...(((.(((...((((....)))).((((((.((((((.((((((.((((((.((((((((((.((((((.(((((.((((.((((..((((...)))).))).)))))).))))).)))))).)))))))).)))))).)))))).)))))).))))))).)))...(((.(((((.(..((((.(..((((.(..((((.(..(((((((.((((((.(((((.((((((.(((.((((((....))))))..)))).)))).))))).)))))).)))))))).)..)))).)..)))).)..)))).)..))))).((((....))))...))).)))...)..).)..)...)...)..((....))"

assert len(target) == 400, len(target)

# parse pairs
stack = []
pairs = {}
for i, c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c == ')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs[j] = i
        pairs[i] = j

# Build candidate: all GC pairs, A for unpaired
# Alternate GC orientation to avoid homo-polymer issues: pair (i,j) -> i=G, j=C ; or alternate
seq = ['A']*400
for i, j in pairs.items():
    if i < j:
        seq[i] = 'G'
        seq[j] = 'C'

s = ''.join(seq)
print("LEN", len(s))
print(s)

# fold
fc = RNA.fold_compound(s)
ss, mfe = fc.mfe()
# bp distance
def bp_dist(a, b):
    pa = set(); stack=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(a):
        if c=='(': stack.append(i)
        elif c==')': pa.add((stack.pop(), i))
    pb=set(); stack=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(b):
        if c=='(': stack.append(i)
        elif c==')': pb.add((stack.pop(), i))
    return len(pa ^ pb), pa, pb
d, pa, pb = bp_dist(ss, target)
print("bp_dist", d, "mfe", mfe)
print("MFE", ss)
# missing pairs (in target not in mfe)
missing = pb - pa
spurious = pa - pb
print("MISSING", sorted(missing)[:20], "count", len(missing))
print("SPURIOUS", sorted(spurious)[:20], "count", len(spurious))
